catalog.title: Brand site
catalog.summary: A marketing site for a company the model invents, with its own identity and real copy.
catalog.requirement: 6+ sections, 900+ words in the brand's voice, SVG identity, one working interactive element

catalog.title: Editorial feature
catalog.summary: A long-form magazine feature with its own layout system, data figures and reading tools.
catalog.requirement: 1200+ words, 6+ layout devices, section nav with progress, 3+ data figures, footnotes

catalog.title: Storefront
catalog.summary: A complete product catalogue and cart flow for products the model invents.
catalog.requirement: 12+ items, variants that change price and stock, working cart with undo, 3-step demo checkout

catalog.title: Original 2D game
catalog.summary: A 2D game built on a mechanic the model invents, not a genre it copies.
catalog.requirement: Invented core verb, 3+ interacting systems, 6+ juice effects, win and lose, self-test that passes

catalog.title: Original 3D game
catalog.summary: A three.js game whose mechanic only exists because the world has depth.
catalog.requirement: Custom ShaderMaterial, invented 3D mechanic, 6+ juice effects, win and lose, self-test that passes

catalog.title: Two-player duel
catalog.summary: A same-device two-player game with an AI opponent that plays by the same rules.
catalog.requirement: One device, two humans or human vs AI, 3 fair difficulty levels, invented mechanic, self-test

catalog.title: Procedural image
catalog.summary: One large still image generated entirely in code, with its own technique and palette.
catalog.requirement: 2400px+ render, seeded and reproducible, 3+ live controls, PNG export at 2x

catalog.title: Short animated film
catalog.summary: A 45–90 second animated film with its own storyboard, soundtrack and timeline.
catalog.requirement: 45–90 s, 5–7 scenes, synthesised score, scrubbing timeline, WebM recording

catalog.title: 3D shader piece
catalog.summary: A real-time 3D or raymarched art piece where the shader is the idea.
catalog.requirement: Custom GLSL doing the real work, three movements, pointer/scroll/gyro response, 60fps, capture

catalog.title: Branching story
catalog.summary: An interactive fiction with real prose, state that matters, and endings that pay off.
catalog.requirement: 1500+ words, 12+ nodes, 3+ endings, state that changes scenes, save and restore

catalog.title: Music machine
catalog.summary: A playable instrument, sequencer or generative music machine that sounds intentional.
catalog.requirement: 8+ synthesised voices, 3+ scales, drift-free clock, WAV export, pattern save/load

catalog.title: Playful toy
catalog.summary: A toy with no score and no fail state, built to be played with for ten minutes.
catalog.requirement: First interaction in 2s, 3+ modes, a hidden surprise, Save PNG, URL-shareable state

catalog.title: Interactive explainer
catalog.summary: A rigorous, interactive explanation of a hard idea, with honest references.
catalog.requirement: Correct mathematics, 3+ live parameters, worked example, 5-question quiz, honest sources

catalog.title: Living simulation
catalog.summary: A system that actually evolves, with real integration, scenarios and live plots.
catalog.requirement: 4+ coupled variables, stated integrator, 3+ scenarios, 3+ live plots, CSV export, analytic check

catalog.title: One idea
catalog.summary: A single original interactive idea, executed completely. The purest test of taste.
catalog.requirement: One invented interaction, a second layer to discover, a real payoff, a way to capture it
